name: Venomancer: Empowered Exoskeleton lengthens Chitin Rush

steps.label: Chitin Rush dash length is unmodified without Empowered Exoskeleton
Chitin Rush costs resource without Empowered Exoskeleton
Empowered Exoskeleton adds 5 yd to the dash length (effect radius)
Empowered Exoskeleton makes Chitin Rush free

contract: #889: Empowered Exoskeleton (804993) promises +5 yd Chitin Rush range and -100% cost. Chitin Rush (803570) has range 0 and dashes its effect radius (20 yd), so the range modifier must be delivered as a radius modifier; the cost clause is native and is asserted as well.
